hor1.text: At Isstvan V, forces that appeared loyal revealed their treachery and ambushed loyalists.

hor2.text: After the Heresy, the Imperium endured under the Emperor’s incapacitated presence and became shaped by fear and ritual.

hor3.text: The Horus Heresy officially began with the Isstvan III Atrocity while Horus's duplicity remained unrevealed.

hor4.text: The campaign targets loyalists within Horus’s legion and three allied Traitor Legions.

hor5.text: Morturg became a commander of the Loyalist resistance.

hor6.text: The civil war forced commanders to choose between competing allegiances.

hor7.text: The Emperor fought Horus aboard the flagship, killed him, and was mortally wounded.

hor8.text: Angron disobeyed Horus and led the World Eaters to the surface to kill survivors.

hor9.text: Horus’s forces besieged Terra during the final phase of the Heresy.

hor10.text: The Solar War was a battle for the Sol System in which traitor infiltration, raids, Dark Mechanicum attacks, and attempted breakouts from besieged traitor-controlled Mars tested the Throneworld’s defenses.
